[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-mf[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Schema editors that arrange instantly and pick emoji beautifully[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The album Schema Card and the Bank setup card move fields, choices,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]categories, groups, and rules any distance with an instant local [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]preview, then save the whole arrangement as one guarded bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]transaction with one commit and one Undo. Every emoji prompt is a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]searchable Emoji Slot. Both cards use a calmer, contextual layout. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Bob stays the only writer, and nothing is saved without a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]successful preview of the exact envelope.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]10[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]9[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Quick fixes that ship before the redesign[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]quick-fixes[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]quick-fixes: stop q from cancelling inside bank inputs, keep a bank [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]category's emoji when its label is edited, make Alt+J/K work with macOS [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Option, and port bob's split_icon so album choice splitting matches [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Rust.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Pure arrangement engine[/bold #D7AFFF]                                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]arrange-engine[dim] · [dim][/dim]after quick-fixes[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]arrange-engine: add a DOM-free projected-order model with nudges, edges,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gap placement, local undo, anchor rebase, and a save marker. Add album [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and bank envelope compilers checked by a simulator, plus gap-hint labels[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and FLIP planning.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob-emoji search upgrades and api v1[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]emoji-engine[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]emoji-engine: normalize multi-token queries with tiered ranking, look up[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pasted glyphs, add catalog categories, CLDR keywords when chosen, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]label suggestions. Expose a frozen versioned api on bob-emoji that keeps[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the editor :shortcode: menu.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Album Schema Card visual refresh and region painting[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]album-card-shell[dim] · [dim][/dim]after arrange-engine[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]album-card-shell: give the album card one title line, the details row as[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the header subtitle, pills, a one-line status rule, and a contextual [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hint strip with a ⋯ action list. Remove Preview this edit, latch Enter, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and repaint regions instead of rebuilding the modal.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Album arrangement editing and one-envelope save[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]album-arrange[dim] · [dim][/dim]after album-card-shell[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]album-arrange: wire the engine into the album card. Alt+J/K, ends, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]counts, and m move-to change a local projection with FLIP, deltas, and a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pending bar. A latched quiet/loud Enter saves one envelope in the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]background, and u steps back or stages Undo. The save survives closing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the card.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Shared Emoji Slot in the album card[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]album-emoji-slot[dim] · [dim][/dim]after album-arrange, emoji-engine[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]album-emoji-slot: build the shared Emoji Slot (glyph well, preview chip,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and in-card panel served by the bob-emoji api, with a plain fallback). [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Wire it into album choice add/edit and field-add initial choices with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]duplicate badges, IME guards, and a strict Esc ladder.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Add-and-place ghosts and pointer drag[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]album-place-drag[dim] · [dim][/dim]after album-emoji-slot[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]album-place-drag: show a ghost chip or row for choice-add and field-add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that the move keys place before the single add op. Add shared pointer [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]drag with grip handles, an insertion caret, autoscroll, and Esc cancel [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]for album items.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bank setup card arrangement parity[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]bank-arrange[dim] · [dim][/dim]after album-place-drag[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bank-arrange: bring arrangement editing to bank categories, groups, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rules (always loud) without per-move confirm stages. Paint bob's dry-run[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]order and hotkey shifts, check bob's order against the local one, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add region painting, Ctrl+Z semantics, and saves that survive closing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the card.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Emoji Slot for bank categories[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]bank-emoji-slot[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bank-arrange[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bank-emoji-slot: use the Emoji Slot for setup-card new/edit category and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the category card's new-category stage. Compose the emoji and label into[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bob's fused label, keep the emoji unless the user clears it, and draw [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]suggestions from bank vocabulary.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]End-to-end acceptance, measurements, and decision record[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]acceptance[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bank-emoji-slot[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]acceptance: run real-Obsidian walkthroughs that count commits for both [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cards, plus timing budgets and light/dark/reduced-motion screenshots. Do[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a final consistency pass, write the decision record, and propose [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]follow-ups for CLI save-latency trims.[/#D7D7AF]
